newsitem.title: USA: 16 sought in waters off Florida after sinking.
newsitem.headline: 16 sought in waters off Florida after sinking.

text.p: Sixteen people were missing after reporting on Sunday night that they were abandoning their sinking yacht off Fort Pierce, Florida, the Coast Guard said on Monday.
The Coast Guard said the Intrepid, a 65-foot (22-metre) sailboat, sent out a distress call saying it was sinking and everyone on board was escaping on a life raft.

It said four aircraft searched all night for the life raft and on Monday two aircraft and a cutter were still looking for it about 30 miles (48 km) off Fort Pierce, on Florida's east coast north of Palm Beach.
The Coast Guard said seas in the area were rough with waves up to 7 feet (2 metres) high.
